coverage.summary: Applies to rental dwelling units offered for rent by housing providers for residential purposes. Units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are excluded.
coverage.owner_conditions: Dwelling units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are not 'rental dwelling units'.

result.notes: Coverage comes from the 'rental dwelling unit' definition in N.J.S.A. 46:8-54 (D065). The act covers ordinary rental units. Its only coverage carve-out is owner-occupied premises of four or fewer units, so requires_unknown_facts is set to false. The act sets no unit-count minimum, construction-date limit or landlord-size condition. The original coverage values were confirmed and kept, except that requires_unknown_facts was changed from null to false.
